description:
Request for Quote - N6883626QS0037 for Shear Maintenance in Gulfport, MS. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested.

Set-Aside: 100% Small Business

Requirement

The Department of the Navy, NAVSUP FLC Jacksonville, requests quotes for Shear Maintenance (AS 500-14) in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). The Government anticipates award of a Firm-Fixed-Price, purchase order. 

Place of Performance / Delivery

Primary Location: Gulfport, Mississippi (specific delivery sites will be identified in individual orders)

Delivery/Performance Schedule: See attached DOR. 

Submission of Quotes

Due Date/Time: No later than the posted due date on this notice. Late quotes may not be considered.
Submission Method: Email to yaynel.c.yambo.civ@us.navy.mil and robert.s.edwards42.civ@us.navy.mil with subject line: “N6883626QS037 – Vendor Name”.

Required Quote Contents

  1. Company Information: Legal name, UEI, CAGE, business size/status under NAICS 324121, point of contact, email, phone.
  2. Technical: Follow Technical Volume requirements/instructions in 52.212-1 in the solicitation (page 25 of 44).
  3. Pricing: Complete, sign and submit the SF 1449 with a CLIN schedule that includes unit prices (page 3) and extended totals. 
  4. Certifications: Current SAM registration (or confirmation they are current in SAM).
  5. Past Performance (optional but encouraged): Recent, relevant .

Important: Follow all submission and volume/format instructions contained in the attached SF 1449 Solicitation.
